titles.native: らんま1/2 天道家のおよびでない奴ら!

description:
Features Nabiki Tendo reviewing the series, where she discusses various characters that the Tendo family has had to tolerate. Includes new animation of Nabiki hanging around the house, taking a bath, and wondering about the true identity of P-chan. Was only available through the Kitty Animation Circle.

( Edited source: furinkan.com/ranma/anime/specials.html)
